meaning: Payload-aware source-derived controls for named algebraic sums and their recursive value structure, without erasing payloads or nominal boundaries.
coverage: Start from every qualified source node. A payload-bearing Enum is ready only when every declared variant and transitive named value dependency has an implemented witness adapter. This installment supports scalar String/Bool/exact UInt64, inline sums, optional/list/set and named Enum-only closures. Any Entity/Value Object dependency retains the entire owner sum as not_evaluable with its exact dependency reason until an independent factory-witness adapter is implemented. Do not filter variants or claim full project coverage.
oracle: Derive normalized value views, equality/key distinctions, exact key framing and malformed-input failure codes recursively from checked source types, not generated renderers or native results. Cover every declared variant, scalar boundaries, explicit absence versus missing payload, ordered duplicate-preserving lists, canonical duplicate-rejecting sets, inline structural sums and nominal named cases. Exact UInt64 representations normalize to bigint without truncation.
execution: Construct only case recipes through checked pure sum and plain Enum components, in the existing pinned permission-restricted child with no inherited credentials or filesystem-write/network/subprocess grants. Import only the exact forward native dependency closure. Never execute application Operations, Workflows, servers, integrations, record factories, inferred Rules or target publication.
observations: Compare exact independent normalized view and semantic key, own membership, fresh-copy equality, baseline equality, metadata and recursive freeze. Reject raw, clone and foreign-module named cases. Inspect input descriptors recursively before/after execution without invoking getters; accessor/coercion callbacks must not execute. Preserve strict case identity/order, all currentness dependencies, cleanup and bounded failure accounting.
bounds: Reuse 4096 cases per node, 65536 per project, 8 MiB payload and existing subprocess ceilings. Bound recursive witness expansion at 4096 recipes and depth 64; capacity exhaustion remains not_evaluable, never truncated passing evidence.
compatibility: Keep all existing source field/sum semantics, factory/Rule requirements, selected profiles, relationships, generated artifacts, defaults and prior 44 source pins unchanged. This additive verification extension is finite test evidence, not universal equivalence, complete runtime conformance or cross-generator/safe-output qualification.
validation: Every variant including null-payload and explicit optional payload
Full-width UInt64, ordered lists, duplicate rejection and canonical sets
Nested inline/named sums and plain Enum ownership
Deep no-mutation/getter execution and forged/foreign case rejection
Syntax-valid emitted-code tag, payload, equality, ownership and collection mutants
Record dependencies remain visible, source capsule preservation and complete CLI regressions
